thesis: Corvane proposes accelerating margin and revenue growth by launching a paid digital membership program, AI reordering tools, and geographic expansion powered by inside-sales reps and existing IT resources.

assumptions.claim: At least 30% of top 500 contractor accounts will pay $49 per month for Corvane Pro.
assumptions.quote: We expect at least 30% of our top 500 accounts to subscribe within six months

test.method: Concierge pre-sale campaign where reps pitch 50 randomly selected top accounts on an advance annual or monthly Corvane Pro subscription.
test.metric: Percentage of contacted accounts signing a binding paid subscription agreement.

assumptions.claim: Corvane's historical ERP order records are sufficiently accurate and structured to train predictive AI reorder algorithms without extensive remediation.
assumptions.quote: Our ERP order history is clean enough to train demand forecasts that predict what each contractor will need next week.

test.method: Data quality audit of a random sample of 500 historical order records across top product categories.
test.metric: Percentage of sampled order records with valid, unique product codes and complete order metadata.

assumptions.claim: Branch and inside-sales reps will actively promote digital membership adoption to their accounts despite current commission arrangements.
assumptions.quote: Reps are the fastest path to adoption because contractors trust their branch contacts.

test.method: Pilot outreach task asking 10 inside and counter reps to introduce digital ordering to 10 accounts each with no change to standard commission rules.
test.metric: Percentage of assigned reps who complete all 10 customer introductions within the test window.

assumptions.claim: The existing four-person IT team possesses sufficient unallocated bandwidth to build the AI reordering system immediately.
assumptions.quote: Start the reorder-model build with the existing IT team.

test.method: Resource capacity review with IT leadership mapping hours committed to ERP upgrade against AI build requirements.
test.metric: Dedicated developer hours available per week for non-ERP projects through Q3.

assumptions.claim: Target contractors are willing to transition ordering workflows online rather than ordering via phone or branch counters.
assumptions.quote: Corvane's contractors are ready to move ordering online

test.method: Fake-door or quick-portal test offering 100 active phone/counter contractors a 5% instant discount on their next order if completed online.
test.metric: Percentage of contacted contractors who submit their next order through the portal.

assumptions.claim: National competitors will not develop or launch competing regional same-day delivery services within the next 12 months.
assumptions.quote: national players have not yet built local same-day delivery, and they will not respond within the next 12 months.

test.method: Competitive mystery shopping and regional job-posting analysis of top 3 national competitors across Corvane's 38 branch markets.
test.metric: Number of competitor facilities or job postings in Corvane markets offering same-day jobsite delivery.
test.go_if: 0 regional facilities or active postings found
test.kill_if: >= 2 regional facilities or active postings found

assumptions.claim: Corvane can successfully acquire contractor accounts in new metro areas purely via digital membership without physical branch counters.
assumptions.quote: Expand to two new metro areas in the second half of the year, using Pro as the entry offer rather than opening full branches.

test.method: Direct sales outreach and digital landing page campaign targeting 100 licensed general contractors in one target expansion metro offering Corvane Pro delivery.
test.metric: Percentage of qualified leads expressing intent to buy without a local branch.

conflicts.tension: Growth strategy calls for hiring 20 new inside-sales reps while workforce guidelines dictate a firm hiring freeze and attrition.
conflicts.quote_a: Hire 20 inside-sales reps in Q1 to call every top-500 account and sign them up for Pro.
conflicts.quote_b: A hiring freeze holds through the end of next fiscal year.

conflicts.tension: Growth strategy assumes IT can begin building the AI reorder engine immediately, whereas workforce draft shows IT is fully committed to the ERP upgrade until Q3.
conflicts.quote_a: Start the reorder-model build with the existing IT team.
conflicts.quote_b: IT is fully committed to the ERP upgrade until Q3.

conflicts.tension: Growth strategy claims ERP order data is clean enough to train predictive models, while workforce draft states one-fifth of records have duplicate or mislabeled codes.
conflicts.quote_a: Our ERP order history is clean enough to train demand forecasts that predict what each contractor will need next week.
conflicts.quote_b: the team has flagged duplicate and mislabeled product codes in roughly a fifth of historical orders.
